title: Embedding modes and length extrapolation (token_type_pe vs. token_type_nope vs. nope)
question: How do section-coupled sinusoidal position_ids (token_type_pe), token_type_ids alone (token_type_nope), and causal masking alone (nope) compare on in-domain convergence speed vs. zero-shot extrapolation to operand lengths longer than those seen in training?
